basis: Complete selected Model/Entity/Renderer Java source read; fixed remote sources fetched and compared to available cache. Exact Citadel 5633260 animation interpolation/end semantics not read here. No runtime proof.
held_object_socket: None declared by these body/model/render classes; horn hierarchy is anatomy, not handheld item mount.
death_contact: No own dedicated death/hurt model clip or terrain/contact solver in selected files. Inherited MobRenderer/LivingEntity death handling not closed. Does not qualify for quadruped death-contact register.
structure: 13 nodes/12 edges/13 box calls; body8×8×18 →neck4×9×4 →head5×5×5 →snout/ears/horns; four3×12×3 legs attached to body; tail4×5×0 plane.
Neck default+15deg, head-15deg establishes a continuous upright neck/head direction. No segmented knees/jaw.
FrontlegR pivotX+2.5 but box spans localX[-6.5,-3.5]; left pivot+2.5 local[-1.5,1.5]. Geometry is left/right but pivots are asymmetric: cannot infer rotational behavior from bind pose symmetry.
layers: setup resetsdefault→animate→faceTarget on neck/head→idle→RUNNING boolean selects run vs walk abruptly, no explicit run transition progress.
RUN gait pairs forelegs in phase and rearlegs opposite, fore bob, rear flap and large body bob; walk uses diagonal alternation and head/neck counter walk.
Tail6×2+reset2=14; ears6×2+reset7=19 vs declared20; eat5+5×4+reset5=30. Eat includes body pitch10/Y+2, alllegs counter-10, neck100/120 and head-40/-50 alternating.
entry_effect_end: Server idle at NO_ANIMATION random1/70 and absent or lastattacker>30distance; grass/random1/3 picks eat else ears/tail. No stop-navigation or RUNNING guard in this idle entry.
Successful hurt sets revengeCooldown100..249 on nearby same-class herd in15×7.5×15 inflated area. Each entity uses its own cooldown to RUNNING and base-speed switch.

Panic AI MOVE-only: requires living last attacker; propagates lastattacker to nearby canPanic same-type mobs, chooses away position; start navigates and running=true; stop running=false but does not stop nav or clear last attacker. AI running flag is not entity RUNNING sync.
Cooldown decrement then equals0 clears lastattacker and RUNNING; can reach-1. NBT restores only GazelleRunning, not revengeCooldown or hasSpedUp, so sustained post-load running is not established.

No custom hurt method cancels existing clip. Running and eat can therefore be selected simultaneously by source conditions; this is a risk to inspect in full replay, not a demonstrated native defect. AnimationHandler called at tick end; setter only assigns.
render: Renderer .8scale, shadow.4, normal gazelle.png only, no custom added layers.
Young body.5 translateY1.5/Z.125, head1.75 scales descendants, horns additionally.4; restores numeric scales on normal return but retains shouldScaleChildren=true.
application: Keep chest/neck/head transitions as a clear directional sequence and let atlas body bands run continuously; avoid treating each cube as its own bordered object.
Use a matched body-specific movement pattern; abrupt flags and ungated eating are limitations to test, not techniques to copy.
Do not equate save flag with complete pose lifecycle; trace its clock, runtime setter and frame overlays.
